$description: Semantic app, brand, status, and surface tokens for light and dark modes.

backgroundHover.$description: Primary command hover background in light mode.

backgroundHoverDark.$description: Primary command hover background in dark mode.

foreground.$description: Text or icon color on the yellow primary button.

backgroundHover.$description: Secondary quiet-fill hover in light mode.

backgroundHoverDark.$description: Secondary quiet-fill hover in dark mode.

background.$description: Success command background in light mode.

backgroundDark.$description: Success command background in dark mode.

backgroundHover.$description: Success command hover background in light mode. Step-10 hover companion to the green solid fill.

backgroundHoverDark.$description: Success command hover background in dark mode. Step-10 hover companion to the green solid fill.

foreground.$description: Text or icon color on success command backgrounds.

background.$description: Destructive command background in light mode.

backgroundDark.$description: Destructive command background in dark mode.

backgroundHover.$description: Destructive command hover background in light mode. Step-10 hover companion to the red solid fill.

backgroundHoverDark.$description: Destructive command hover background in dark mode. Step-10 hover companion to the red solid fill.

foreground.$description: Text or icon color on destructive command backgrounds.

background.$description: Neutral solid command background in light mode.

backgroundDark.$description: Neutral solid command background in dark mode.

backgroundHover.$description: Neutral solid command hover background in light mode.

backgroundHoverDark.$description: Neutral solid command hover background in dark mode.

foreground.$description: Label on the neutral solid — mode-aware for AA contrast on the gray fill.

foregroundDark.$description: Label on the neutral solid in dark mode.

background.$description: Quiet default button fill in light mode.

backgroundDark.$description: Quiet default button fill in dark mode.

backgroundHover.$description: Default button hover fill in light mode.

backgroundHoverDark.$description: Default button hover fill in dark mode.

foreground.$description: Default button label in light mode.

foregroundDark.$description: Default button label in dark mode.

background.$description: Ghost tier rests with no fill and no border.

foreground.$description: Ghost label at rest in light mode.

foregroundDark.$description: Ghost label at rest in dark mode.

foregroundHover.$description: Ghost label on hover in light mode. The lift is mandatory.

foregroundHoverDark.$description: Ghost label on hover in dark mode. The lift is mandatory.

backgroundHover.$description: Shared quiet-fill hover step in light mode.

backgroundHoverDark.$description: Shared quiet-fill hover step in dark mode.

heightMd.$description: Medium button box. The site top-bar CTA size.

paddingX.$description: Horizontal padding for lg, md and sm.

nav.$description: Sticky site/marketing top bar. Colours live in semantic surface.*.nav*.

heightCompact.$description: Sticky top bar height on narrow viewports.

ctaHeight.$description: The top-bar CTA box. Always the md button.

borderHover.$description: shadcn-friendly alias of --field-border-hover. Always aliases the field token so the two name systems cannot drift.

background.$description: Form-control fill. Fields stay on the app background surface, even inside a raised panel.

borderFocus.$description: Focused form-control border. Focus matches hover and does not use the yellow focus shadow.

borderFocusDark.$description: Dark-mode focused form-control border. Focus matches hover and does not use the yellow focus shadow.

ring.$description: Quiet field focus ring. Brand-yellow shadow focus is reserved for buttons, links, nav, and TV focus.

ringDark.$description: Dark-mode quiet field focus ring. Brand-yellow shadow focus is reserved for buttons, links, nav, and TV focus.

background.$description: Raised panel background on the app background surface.

backgroundDark.$description: Dark-mode raised panel background on the app background surface.

invertForeground.$description: Text or icon color on invert command backgrounds in light mode.

invertForegroundDark.$description: Text or icon color on invert command backgrounds in dark mode.

border.$description: Row divider. File lists divide with a hairline, never zebra stripes or per-row cards.

icon.$description: Every file kind takes this, not just the folder — folder, video, audio, image, archive, generic file alike. Utility and chrome icons stay neutral.

badgeBackground.$description: Unread count disc — darkened red so white numerals clear AA at 9px. Fixed in both modes.

width.$description: Fixed on web. Touch surfaces use a bottom sheet instead.

yellow.$description: Initial-on-color avatar palette. Fixed in both modes; the chip carries its own contrast.

foreground.$description: White initials — every palette entry except yellow and orange.

foregroundWarm.$description: Warm dark initials on yellow and orange.

radius.$description: Inline, in-page messaging. Persists until the condition clears — a toast does not.

track.$description: Seek, volume, stepped numeric. The buffered band is what makes it a scrubber.

hitHeight.$description: 44px on touch — the knob grows, the track does not.

itemSize.$description: Numbered paging. Load-more and infinite scroll carry no chrome of their own.

text.$description: TV uses two semantic text roles. The tertiary name remains as a deprecated alias of secondary so existing consumers keep working; TV text is solid.

primary.$description: Row titles, modal option labels, and button labels.

secondary.$description: Row sublines, modal titles, section headers, and accessories.

nightly.$description: Nightly/staging store-art flavor: TestFlight, Play internal/closed tracks, and staging TV sideloads. True-black sky with scattered stars; the mark stays exactly as production draws it, so the surface alone carries the flavor.

background.$description: True black, one step past production charcoal; carries the star field so a staging build is unmistakable next to the shipping app.

accent.$description: Unlike dev, nightly does not recolor the mark: the accent is the brand yellow and the retro wordmark keeps its yellow drop-shadow. Present so emitters can express the flavor as a complete set rather than a special case.

star.$description: Star colour. Stars are scattered, never gridded: three sizes at roughly 36%, 62%, and 95% opacity with the faint ones dominating. Static — never animated, blurred, or glowing.

moon.$description: Full moon disc in the brand yellow, placed top-left. Its own token so a platform can place the moon without hard-coding the brand value.

moonCrater.$description: Craters one step darker than the moon disc. Low contrast on purpose: texture at icon size, not holes.

tv.$description: The portable 10-foot scale. These mode "tv" tokens are graph data for platform adapters and are not emitted into web CSS; preview support CSS declares matching --tv-* properties under .tv. TV has no mono face, and its z-order is distinct from the web stack.

video.$description: On-video and hero-art plate colors. Fixed values by design: the video underneath does not change with the theme.

background.$description: Letterbox / video plate. True black, not the app background.

heroScrimTop.$description: Top stop of the warm-black wash behind hero/poster art.

heroScrimBottom.$description: Bottom stop of the hero wash. Near-black but warm — never pure black, which reads blue next to the art.

textOnVideo.$description: Player chrome over video — always white, never a theme token.

label.$description: text.label · GTAmerica-Md. Screen titles, and the file-row icon size.

caption.$description: text.caption · GTAmerica-Rg. Row subline and button icons. TV has no mono face, so the Berkeley Mono numeric rule is web and mobile only: the size subline renders in GT America, asking for its tnum tabular figures where the platform can select OpenType features and accepting proportional figures where it cannot.

smol.$description: text.smol · GTAmerica-Rg. Button labels, rendered uppercase.

md.$description: The workhorse step: uniform list-row padding, row gap, and header padding-bottom.

x.$description: Horizontal safe-area ratio. Platform adapters multiply this value by viewport width.

y.$description: Vertical safe-area ratio. Platform adapters multiply this value by viewport height.

radius.$description: radii.default — one radius for every 10-foot surface.

z.$description: zIndices. NOT the web --z-* order: on TV, overlay sits ABOVE toast. Emit the two scales separately and never fold TV into the web stack order.

overlay.$description: Above toast — the opposite of the web scale, where --z-notification (1400) sits above --z-modal (1300).

yellow.$description: put.io brand yellow (canonical hex #FDCE45). The resting brand fill is the same in light and dark modes.

solidHover.$description: Primary-button hover yellow for light mode.
Primary-button hover yellow for dark mode.

color.$description: Compat name kept for existing web consumers — alias of elevation.shadowColor so the two can never drift.

mono.$description: The single mono face: numerics, timestamps, file sizes, ETAs, counts, code, logs, magnet URIs, identifiers, and filenames. Web and mobile only — TV has no mono face.

sm.$description: Caption and button labels — production fontSize 0.

base.$description: Body, labels, inputs — production fontSize 1; equals the responsive root (14px, 15px at >= breakpoint.lg).

2xl.$description: Fixed display tier — does not scale with the responsive root.

3xl.$description: Fixed display tier — does not scale with the responsive root.

4xl.$description: Compatibility alias for the former 4xl tier; new surfaces should use fontSize.3xl or fontSize.display.

display.$description: Fixed display tier for brand display moments.

tv.$description: The corner radius for every 10-foot surface — list rows, buttons, sheets, cards, code tiles, and keys. TV uses one radius, not a scale; the only other radii on TV are intentional pills and circles.

z.$description: Stacking scale. Gapped for platform chrome — never invent z-index numbers in apps.

breakpoint.$description: Responsive breakpoints, lifted from app.put.io's BREAKPOINTS. Generator-facing: CSS media queries cannot read custom properties, so emitters bind these as Tailwind screens, StyleX consts, or documented literals.

lg.$description: The root font-size steps from 14px to 15px at this width.

shadow.$description: Compat name kept for existing web consumers — alias of surface.dark.shadowColor so the two can never drift.
